description.html: Lifetime Guarantee View Details > Product Description The Vive Folding Commode is a freestanding bedside commode that works at the bedside or placed directly over most standard and elongated toilets as a safety rail. The corrosion-resistant steel frame supports up to 350 pounds, with padded handrails on both sides and non-slip leg caps for stability on any surface. Seat height adjusts from 16.5" to 22.5" with locking pins and handrails adjust from 24" to 30". The 7.5 quart pail includes a cover, splashguard and carrying handle and the unit works with standard commode liners. This portable commode folds flat without tools for travel or storage, making it just as useful away from home as in the bedroom. Caregivers helping with transfers will find our Transfer Belts a practical addition alongside it. Suited to seniors, post-surgery recovery and anyone with limited mobility, this foldable commode chair is backed by Vive Health's lifetime guarantee. Those placing it over an existing toilet can browse our Raised Toilet Seats for height options and our Toilet Safety Rails offer a related alternative for over-toilet support. Remove the pail and set it to the side. Carefully release the front crossbar and push it down to rest against the back of the frame. Then, fold the front legs inward one at a time to rest against the back of the frame. What size is the pail? The large, 7.5 quart pail is 13.5” in diameter. Does the commode come with a splash guard? Yes! The commode includes a 7.5 quart pail with a carrying handle, cover and splashguard. What is the weight limit for the folding commode? The commode safely supports up to 350 pounds. How wide is the toilet seat? The toilet seat is 13.75” wide. How wide is it between the armrests? The commode is 18” between the armrests. Can I use the frame alone with my standard toilet? Yes! The folding commode can be used as a toilet safety rail on most standard and elongated toilets. What is the maximum seat height? The seat height is adjustable from 16.5” to 22.5”. Does this commode come with a lid? Yes, the folding commode includes a traditional toilet seat and lid, as well as a cover and splash guard for the commode pail. Will it easily fold for transport while vacationing? Yes! The commode easily folds for storage or travel. Is the size of the hole close to that of a regular toilet? Yes, the inner diameter of the toilet seat is 11”. Uses: Freestanding foldable commode option for seniors, those with limited mobility and those recovering from surgery or injury Materials: Coated steel frame Closed-cell foam handles Composite pail Dimensions: Adjustable height at the seat: 16.5” to 22.5” Adjustable height at the handrails: 24” to 30” Width at the base: 21.75” Width at the arm rails: 18” Depth: 19” Pail diameter: 13.75” How To Assemble: Open the commode frame. Insert the front crossbar into the front legs until an audible click is heard. Turn the frame upside down, then insert each leg by depressing the push pins and sliding in place until an audible click is heard. Turn the frame right-side up, then insert the outward-facing backrest into the frame until an audible click is heard. Attach the toilet seat and lid. Lower the splash guard and commode bucket into the frame.
